name: Jude
title: Jude — Contend for the Faith
tagline: Once for all delivered — keep yourselves in God’s love.

author.traditional: Jude, brother of James (hence of the Lord).

purpose: Call to contend; pronounce doom on false teachers; keep the beloved.
christ: Only Master and Lord; keeps you from stumbling.
jesus_in_this_book: Only Master and Lord; keeps you from stumbling.
how_to_read: Pair with 2 Peter. Contending is not crankiness — it is love for the flock.
watchman_charge: Contend. Build yourselves up. Snatch others from the fire. Trust Him who keeps you.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
